objective: Measure whether a 2.5-second shifted pass recovers notes obscured by MuScriptor's artificial five-second decode boundaries without globally unioning false notes.
principalExperiment: Keep the primary pass except inside one pre-registered radius around each primary five-second cut; inside that zone, replace it with the shifted pass that heard the same event near its window centre.

motivation.source: phase94-v001 change attribution on the complete six-song validation set
motivation.interpretation: The boundary-associated error rate is about 3.1 times higher, so context placement is a stronger next hypothesis than another blanket note-on weight.

limitations: This doubles model decoding work before any later optimization or selective routing.
The radius is development-tuned on six opened validation songs and needs the sealed test after the entire winner is frozen.
The inference pass changes note facts only; Pianella-style arrangement remains a separate downstream stage.
